title: catalog.item_updated v1
description: FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) — fields are top-level, matching the real producer. Emitted when an existing catalog item is persisted after an update. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-catalog-go RedisPublisher.PublishItemUpdated (internal/service/redis_publisher.go:228-230), which XADDs the SAME itemPayload(it) helper (redis_publisher.go:212-220) used by PublishItemCreated/PublishItemDeactivated to the configured stream (default 'catalog.item_updated', config.go:189, env EVENTBUS_STREAM_CATALOG_ITEM_UPDATED). Registered under the producer's real event_type key ('catalog.item_updated', underscore) — no schema previously existed for this event type at all (ErrNoSchema fail-open). 'event_type' is documentary only per catalog.item_created.v1.json's precedent (see that file for the full rationale) — itemPayload never embeds it. DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-catalog-crm-agenda.

event_type.description: Documentary only — never present on the real wire payload; itemPayload (redis_publisher.go:212-220) does not set this key.

item_id.description: UUID of the updated catalog item (it.ID.String(), redis_publisher.go:214).

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit code, unique per tenant (it.SKU, redis_publisher.go:216).

item_type.description: Catalog entry kind (it.ItemType, redis_publisher.go:218). Left unconstrained — see catalog.item_created.v1.json for the enum-ambiguity rationale.
